note: The core is OpenGMK (GPL-2.0-only) built with this repository's patches (GPL-2.0-only, being changes to OpenGMK's own files and two small stand-in crates) and this repository's integration (MIT, which the GPL-2.0-only whole may include). Compiled in: Mesa's softpipe and OSMesa (MIT), udon's mixer and sound readers (GPL-2.0-only, carried in patches/ without its audio devices), and OpenGMK's Rust dependencies, each taken under its MIT, BSD, Zlib, Unlicense or CC0 option where it offers one (no dependency is Apache-2.0 only; gl_generator, which is, runs only when OpenGMK is built and is not in the package). The core also CARRIES, as data OpenGMK embeds, the default font GameMaker games draw text with (arimo.dat, a GameMaker 8 export of the Arimo font) and the particle shapes OpenGMK draws. It carries no game: the player brings their own GameMaker 8 .exe.
